tools.name: list_verification_tiers
tools.description: List Web Evidence verification tools, prices, and research limits. This tool is free.

tools.name: verify_claim_quick
tools.description: Quick verification for a narrow claim using up to 3 cited sources. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Standard verification with balanced evidence coverage. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: verify_claim_deep
tools.description: Deep verification for compound or contested claims using up to 15 cited sources. Costs $0.12 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: verify_claim_research
tools.description: Research-grade verification with the largest search and evidence budget. Costs $0.25 USDC on Base per call.
